notes.title: StarRupture - Developer Update: September '25
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to our newest Developer Update. This month, we’re reminding you about the new PC Early Access release date on Steam and inviting you to meet the in-game enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a72858e44127ce1f8001279cfbf30c65adb72d0c.jpg[/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/c4ec85263a327837b234519018eeddf7302226a2.png[/img]

In case you missed it, StarRupture will debut in PC Early Access on January 6th, 2026.

We can't wait for you to set foot on the Arcadia-7 planet surface, but we need a little extra time for more polish, more improvements, and more reasons for you to enjoy StarRupture when it launches on Steam early next year.

[previewyoutube=25KyPKN-FD4;full][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e4cc617c1bb09243f7f66a361afb9698cc29c966.png[/img]

The alien race you will encounter during your sentence on Arcadia-7 is known as “Vermin”. Long before you were sent to the planet, the expeditions ahead of you managed to analyze them and categorize them as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1a22678ce00d4f49a73c6c1a894144f626076c35.jpg[/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f86dd2083fa8e2feb25d78518a4fff99d2435dec.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7ac16d0b783d380d91cb9634c44560bc3dee1260.jpg[/img]
The most basic vermin life-form. A great waste of bullet rounds. They usually attack in groups and seem to be the easiest to eliminate, but the fact that they’re quick and move in a “swarmy” manner makes them rather burdensome to deal with. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a5c2ff664fc38e2faa7eac1ccd5a3b7ee32d7687.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ffbc2534efff5c409db8fbc716c7a932806795de.png[/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1f9ab076c36f19a07711f2b1898cbaa3b096c3b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2e56f4a120162ef183392d5f572a163bd9c82432.jpg[/img]
A bigger and more powerful version of the Swarmer. A melee enemy that attacks with its extra sharp spike-shaped arms. When dealing with a Slasher, be sure to spike it with your bullets first rather than get spiked with their arms…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ce097f8cc60b4a53d616d5d28a2e6b188519e5c4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6d904d4deb43b6547be1481b6e21636b0179d5be.gif[/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f473aa145bcdae5a76ff12855091c84e9850d72f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/a37475b78abfd46417050fb7127964bacdab9f6a.jpg[/img]
It’s the biggest melee of the Vermin family. It attacks by charging at you with full speed, deals great damage with its slashing attack, and it’s also capable of blasting a ground wave towards you. Its whole body is covered in armor, but it has one (very specific!) weak point! Co-operation will be greatly required to deal with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b05156a2edef49850b72c17dcaf133e145f15e02.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3f5f868d1f3651fcbce639e9ab207c6206ac8d89.gif[/img]


Watch the micro-trailer video for the melee category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="drHTvpOcDWk;full"][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/774a7a71165caced861d9a9f431eee990ea42eaf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/f24a660b3be43ae453bf2d2006b8d959c12d9f3b.jpg[/img]
It attacks by exploding. These kamikaze aliens go after the player to explode just in front of you. Their internals contain highly infectious gas that may be lethal for you, but for the vermin, it enrages them and makes them even more aggressive. Therefore, strategic extermination of exploders is highly advised.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2bde2b98f899c540e77ebbf453acb00dda8a620f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/c1b3eb55aa7b7d5e12b285b35823308092fce35e.png[/img]

Watch the micro-trailer video for the exploding category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="Cmrn3g9vWjA;full"][/previewyoutube]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/1ff634ad2b46d8e58b94fb0280579b64cfaf1497.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6ac5086e5fb5c14a939126fcf90f4875d25fdbf6.jpg[/img]
A small ranged enemy. When endangered, it protects itself by spitting corrosive acid directly on its targets. Its attack range is rather short, so it’s wise to deal with them from a distance in order to have enough time to dodge their acid spitting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8dbd4b031a257ae2e652cfb1027d6ad2e432a808.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/74a834c95c7c3aca7575ff2f5c47416bc0169401.gif[/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/5300c4e842d62c68b315aa0dee4c06933e657ce4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3693e30a345f7621ed4f93f77e1fab62c6946397.jpg[/img]
A bigger version of the Spitter. It shoots acid projectiles from its tail like a cannon. When their projectile hits a target, it bursts into smaller droplets of acid, just like a fragmentation grenade. Beware not to step into its corrosive acid stains, as it can easily burn through your shield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b6b8b7c821333b5f733a3ccddcd2af505e95463f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ccdd49aef446a258a75795ba47baae99febec675.gif[/img]

Watch the micro-trailer video for the ranged category of enemies down below. 

[previewyoutube="BQPeJ5GA1VQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]


And that’s all for our September StarRupture Developer Update. There are still some secrets we intend to reveal before the game’s Early Access launch on January 6th, so stay tuned for more!

Until next time,
[i]Creepy Jar Team[/i]

notes.title: Open-world space game StarRupture gets surprise delay after huge playtest
notes.notes:
Starfield was a bit of a let-down, but I still think it has potential. Bethesda has been all quiet on the DLC front, but there are countless mods that make those empty planets more interesting. It's no surprise, then, that players are looking for a game that offers those same promises as Starfield, but actually delivers. And after a successful playtest earlier this month, space survival game StarRupture could be ready to step into those shoes. Developer Creepy Jar has now announced the early access release date for the game, as well as a bunch of stats to explain just how well the playtest went.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: No Man's Sky style base building space sim StarRupture launches new playtest
notes.notes:
Once No Man's Sky got over those early hiccups, it became a game to define a generation. One of the best live-service games ever created, it has picked up countless awards for the amount of free updates it has offered its players over the year. But as developer Hello Games moves on to Light No Fire, we're left looking for our next space sim to hit all those same exploration beats. StarRupture wants to step into those enormous shoes. With exploration aplenty, survival mechanics galore, and-of course-base building, this first-person survival game could be the indie to take No Man's Sky's mantle.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Single-Player Playtest available now
notes.notes:
Featuring exciting single-player content, the StarRupture playtest will put you firmly into the treacherous world of Arcadia-7. Simply click the “[i]Request Access[/i]” button now on our Steam Page and enjoy it until July 31st.

While StarRupture is a co-op game at heart, where up to four players work together, we also want to ensure that the game is fun and engaging for those who play solo. 
This playtest will introduce you to the core elements of StarRupture, ranging from base building and exploration to survival and combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/39d1c56d37cd304499b73f115d1eea55e6338d55.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/6460036fe6da7948d75754d545b2dbcb612a41f8.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to StarRupture[/b], an intense first-person open-world survival game where you’ll build sprawling industrial bases, harvest valuable resources, and battle alien monsters. The planet is gorgeous, dangerous, and constantly evolving. Exploration, combat, and creativity are your keys to survival.

Meet Chris Bonnet - aka Prisoner 0212 - aka Scientist. He will be the character you play during the single-player playtest. You will have the opportunity to get to know him a little better during your time on Arcadia-7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/7fc61da4a7cff71290591c7ced5e36b0e2007ab6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧪 Closed Playtest is available for a limited time only![/b][/h3]

The playtest kicks off J[b]uly 29 at 10:00 AM CEST / 1:00 AM PDT[/b] and ends [b]July 31 at 7:00 PM CEST / 10:00 AM PDT[/b]. To join, just head over to our Steam page and click “[i][b]Request Access[/b][/i]”. It’s that easy—and yes, it’s 100% free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/0d6a4f8cad9d9bbf6a3b5d3469a49d0d0d1a71bf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎮 What’s in the Playtest?[/b][/h3]

The StarRupture Single-Player Playtest features over three hours of gameplay split between an early slice of the game featuring the game's core mechanics, a guided tutorial, and a free play option with map restrictions (the Playtest covers around 15% of the Early Access build map), but it’s a first taste of the fun that awaits in StarRupture. 

Some gameplay mechanics will be locked out for now (and left for you to fully explore when the game launches in Early Access this Autumn), such as wildlife, base attack and defense, corporate assignments and rewards over a certain level (6-7 depending on the corporation), the Forgotten Engine, some weapon unlocks with mods, and enemies. So don’t worry about the spoilers, the game will have plenty of fresh and new elements once it launches!

The Playtest supports English VO and interface localisation, and the full list of supported languages for StarRupture’s launch in Early Access is available on the game’s Steam Page.

There is no time limit on your session—play as much (or as little) as you want! However, [b]no co-op for now[/b]—we’re focusing on single-player balance and stability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8d30579e3715ea9492082d22d8de1eae107d7951.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧱 Platforms & Requirements[/b][/h3]

[*] [b]Platform:[/b] PC via Steam
[*] [b]Controller Support:[/b] Not available yet
[*] [b]Ultrawide Support:[/b] Nope—for now
[*] [b]Download Size: [/b]~13 GB (~45 GB after installation)
[*] [b]Hardware Requirements - recommended:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Windows 10 or later, 64-bit 
[*] Intel Core i5 11400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 
[*] 24 GB RAM 
[*] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT 
[*] DirectX 12 
[*] SSD Disk[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🗣️ Languages & Access[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Playtest is English-only for now (interface + audio). You might find a few cases of AI voiceover; they are currently included in the build as placeholders and will be replaced by proper actor recordings for the Early Access release.
[*] No NDA! Share your experience publicly—screenshots, streams, memes, go wild. Maybe show off your wakiest base? Or the most impressive kill?
[*] Players will be selected randomly by Steam and will receive email notifications when they’re eligible to play. No Steam key required—access is added to your account.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]💬 Feedback & Support[/b][/h3]

We want all kinds of feedback—from bug reports to general vibes and gameplay thoughts. Got a bug? Tell us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/starrupture]Discord[/url] or email support@creepyjar.com.

[h3]If you’d like to provide us with your feedback about the playtest, please fill out this short form:[/h3]
https://forms.gle/WXi4ACxAakzCfozA6


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]❓Other Stuff You Should Know[/b][/h3]
[list][*] No criteria to sign up—just a PC and a Steam account
[*] If you’re not selected this round, you’re still in the pool for future tests
[*] There is no official age rating for the game yet, but we recommend 16+ (PEGI 16 / ESRB T guidelines)
[*] Want updates? Follow us on Steam and our socials
[*] Got questions? [url=https://discord.com/invite/starrupture]Join our Discord[/url]—our team and community are there to help
[*] More playtests? Stay tuned on our channels![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧠 The Big Goal[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Steam Playtest coming July 29th
notes.notes:
Featuring exciting single-player content, the StarRupture playtest will put you firmly into the treacherous world of Arcadia-7.

[previewyoutube=3D3dPFaGz00;full][/previewyoutube]
While StarRupture is a co-op game at heart, where up to four players work together, we also want to ensure that the game is fun and engaging for those who play solo. 
This playtest will introduce you to the core elements of StarRupture, ranging from base building and exploration to survival and combat.

Running from July 29th to July 31st, this single-player playtest offers the first exciting taste of StarRupture gameplay, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/]you can now apply for access via Steam on our main product page over here[/url]. Selected players will receive a Steam confirmation that they are eligible to play at the playtest kickoff on July 29th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/94ad5d1225fae9161e0dca0a923af2418d48c590.png[/img]

[h2][b]StarRupture Closed Playtest: What You Need to Know[/b][/h2]

[b]Welcome to StarRupture[/b], an intense first-person open-world survival game where you’ll build sprawling industrial bases, harvest valuable resources, and battle alien monsters—solo or with up to 3 friends. The planet is gorgeous, dangerous, and constantly evolving. Exploration, combat, and creativity are your keys to survival.

[h3][b]🧪 Closed Playtest Incoming![/b][/h3]
The first closed playtest kicks off [b]July 29[/b] and ends [b]July 31[/b]. To join, just [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631270/StarRupture/]head over to our Steam page[/url] and click “[b]Request Access[/b].” It’s that easy—and yes, it’s 100% free!

[h3][b]🎮 What’s in the Playtest?[/b][/h3]
The StarRupture Single-Player Playtest features over three hours of gameplay split between an early slice of the game featuring the game's core mechanics, a guided tutorial, and a free play option with map restrictions (the Playtest covers around 15% of the Early Access build map), but it’s a first taste of the fun that awaits in StarRupture. 

Some gameplay mechanics will be locked out for now (and left for you to fully explore when the game launches in Early Access this Autumn), such as wildlife, base attack and defense, corporate assignments and rewards over a certain level (6-7 depending on the corporation), the Forgotten Engine, some weapon unlocks with mods, and enemies. So don’t worry about the spoilers, the game will have plenty of fresh and new elements once it launches!

The Playtest supports English VO and interface localisation, and the full list of supported languages for StarRupture’s launch in Early Access is available on the game’s Steam Page.

There is no time limit on your session—play as much (or as little) as you want! However, [b]no co-op for now[/b]—we’re focusing on single-player balance and stability.

[h3][b]🧱 Platforms & Requirements[/b][/h3][list]

[*] [b]Controller Support:[/b] Not available yet

[*] [b]Hardware Requirements - recommended:[/b] 
[list]

[*] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT 
[*] DirectX 12 
[*] SSD Disk[/list][/list]
[h3][b]🗣️ Languages & Access[/b][/h3]
Playtest is English-only for now (interface + audio). You might find a few cases of AI voiceover - they are put into the build as placeholders for now, and they will be replaced by proper actor recordings for the release of the title.

No NDA! Share your experience publicly—screenshots, streams, memes, go wild.
Players will be selected randomly by Steam and will receive email notifications when they’re eligible to play. No Steam key required—access is added to your account.

[h3][b]❓Other Stuff You Should Know[/b][/h3][list]
[*] No criteria to sign up—just a PC and a Steam account
[*] If you’re not selected this round, you’re still in the pool for future tests

[*] Want updates? Follow us on Steam and our socials
[*] Got questions? [url=https://discord.com/invite/StarRupture]Join our Discord[/url]—our team and community are there to help

[h3][b]🧠 The Big Goal[/b][/h3]
This test helps us with everything in the early game: bug tracking, game balance, performance, feedback, and - most importantly - how the experience feels. You're helping shape StarRupture before its [b]Early Access launch this Autumn[/b].

notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/75567d10c2e0e02a5deeeb4cb5eb512afd780085.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone!

Welcome to our fresh and exciting Developer Update. This month, we’re inviting you to check out our co-op mode in action, and we’re sharing more info about the effects of the scorching fire wave, and how you can unlock your inner interior designer.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img][/p][p]

After publishing the newest extensive look at StarRupture co-op gameplay video, we have received a ton of feedback and comments!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img]
[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3ab97063cc086577d2c4a96940a5657c74380431.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/eed1507c00b231eadead136283747dbb38338fcc.gif"][/img][/p][p]
The event of the Ruptura’s Fire Wave brings a lot of danger for every living being on the Arcadia-7 planet. But you know what they say - “better safe than sorry”. And that’s where Base Core comes into play. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b0e3d341a2cdfd5547aad6a6fed4fee2baf78cbf.gif"][/img][/p][p]
The passage of the wave of fire does not mean that our base will be wiped out - thanks to the brilliant invention of the Selenian Corp -  Base Cores. Base Cores - crucial for setting up your base - protect and cool down the buildings within their perimeter.  [/p][p]You will also be able to level up the Base Cores so they will be able to restore the factory operations even faster… but it will come at a price, and we’re not necessarily only speaking here about the resources needed to do it…
[/p][previewyoutube="SX5A063JKb4;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="rQ3ctvERoBE;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="UifkRFNJkIY;full"][/previewyoutube][p] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img][/p][p] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/967517a710c4bb314e78d24c900bfa70c00b0903.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8c1912809bfdca49716ad19001e1ca84ba890b4d.png"][/img][/p][p]In StarRupture, you and your friends will be able to not only scratch the itch of creating your own, custom factories but also cool and chilling-looking habitats. 

The Habitats you will build across the planet’s surface will be your safe spots. They’re not only perfect hideouts to stock & refill your supplies and plan your next actions, but also great places to hide from the scorching heat or waves of enemies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/95b46d77e711101449f211f00c801a02edecda01.png"][/img][/p][p]With the building tool, you will be able to create your habitats on the flat lands of the planet, or even more wicked designs on the hill sides. 

You will be able to customize your habitats with additional segments and combine them with vertical or horizontal connectors, add additional airlocks for entrances, and viewports for an extra look at the vistas. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/57c5378a8ff0ad68eaa8d4b52381fe0a45beddda.png"][/img][/p][p]You will also be able to freely decide where to place your storage, progression, and crafting machines. Hopefully, your vision will align with that of your teammates, but if it doesn’t, you can always build another habitat in a different location.[/p][p]We can’t wait to see the creative designs of your habitats you will make in StarRupture. [/p][p]  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img][/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad7f14bf4623df3b35594a618d6c0e27d620a2b7.png"][/img][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8799cb0ae1469f158851b2cd70df002cc5017b9a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad5f34b0171b157f274db8eb8d547413d6c2524e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/d45feac2126553f6a67082f9e55196e9848d464e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/5fc09f12c320ab912935c32303190a62ff26b1f6.png"][/img][/carousel][p]In StarRupture, you will be able to take your 3 friends on a mission in which you will extract, automate, and ship the resources from the Arcadia-7 planet.  [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/340575dc680100ca280480b8ded5ccbd01151058.png"][/img][/p][p]You will mark a new chapter in the history of humanity - and the future of the Claywood Corporation - the company that sent you across the galaxy to explore and document this undiscovered world.   [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8adb55d042144c16fc5228a3f96f980545f77ed1.png"][/img][/p][p]As you progress further, you will uncover different resources that need different machinery to collect them. They have one thing in common, though - Drone Rails. They will not only function as a transportation route to connect them with other machinery or storage buildings, but also as a means to transfer the energy needed to power them.    [/p][p] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img][/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/63b55d5ed3eaa8e898051f9e40c292c35e2791a5.png"][/img][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/fb0521fafd8da4e52b5c6fc71fb00fc6f50a7323.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/dceb1bdf3f33288626ef4a72eab2b07fb3d0cd76.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/585d37ae0b50f0e0540839b685129889e4cad26e.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Last month, we showed you the monoliths - now… we’d like to show you how they’ve changed! [/p][p]They’re now much harder to find - that’s for sure! And they are very much connected to the base defense… but we will reveal more about it later on.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And that’s all for our StarRupture Developer Update in June - we hope you’ve enjoyed the never-before-seen content and that you’re hungry for more! Hello everyone!

We invite you to read our April news recap and give you a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on with our game so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/4b4971e9669fd6404274a9557e464d24e128295f.png[/img]
By the end of February, we reached a big milestone for our game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1631270/view/538846371928604873]we’ve surpassed over 25,000 followers here on Steam[/url]. Thank you for your engagement, and we’re very happy to see you becoming as excited about the game as we are! 

To increase your appetite, we’ve added some brand-new screenshots from the game. If you’d like to see them in HQ, [url=https://discord.com/invite/starrupture]head over to our Discord server, where you can find them all as a special 🎁[/url]. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e26c48359aa2ec7f4832246736499b532370a143.png[/img]
To see more details, we’re inviting you to follow us on our social media. We regularly post new content, such as behind-the-scenes materials on how StarRupture is coming to life. If you’d like to be the first to see them, follow us [url=https://linktr.ee/StarRupture]on your favorite social media channel[/url].

But if you’re not into social media, don’t worry! We’ve prepared a neat recap of what is happening in our development for you so that you can take it all in a big - but condensed - form down below. Enjoy!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ef4d107f3c17fdbec631ac9178ef884242d1c06b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2eaec03770298cbe95b04cedb67119d1a1c33fff.png[/img]

After showing our shooting mechanics in our gameplay teaser, we’ve read and taken your feedback seriously, so you’ll be able to enjoy improved mechanics that now feel much more natural and satisfying. 

We’ve tweaked the animations, added case extractors, re-done the audio feedback, and sprinkled it with some more polish - please see it for yourself on the video below:
[previewyoutube=uqi4n2vD6Wo;full][/previewyoutube] If you’re eager to see more - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nCfCB8ZIwK8]check out our full gameplay trailer in action on YouTube[/url].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3214a8e88c6370527aeacde9c17360990d21ce13.png[/img]

During Valentine’s Day, we gave you a glimpse of how versatile our base building is - it does not only need to be functional, but can be fancy as well! 

Unleash your creativity to build with style, and sometimes you can also use your architectural skills to show somebody your feelings towards them! ;)
[previewyoutube=rlJIHzTo4U4;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2003cefe061f2f6e7176a674df7b3378f2e03523.png[/img]

Did you ever wonder how the various environments of StarRupture are made? Have a look at the video of one of our level designers, meshing a gully and using it to transition from one biome to another. 

Using rocks, vegetation, and dried-up stream beds, he properly transitioned an empty gorge into an authentic gravel desert. Every meter of StarRupture is designed intentionally for you to be fully immersed in our world.
[previewyoutube=k7UCYRMWVMU;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/977ac74cba48967a144bba165e886f5dce0de496.png[/img]

They might not look like much, but they are the blood vessels of your base that will be essential to automate, expand, and deliver rare resources from one location to another. Honestly, they're kind of cute, too.
[previewyoutube=uewUxd3RKTM;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/06e82de41fe6d6863a2ce2292c622b4746f0b68c.png[/img]

notes.title: StarRupture Gameplay Reveal!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We’re very proud to show you for the very first time real gameplay from our upcoming FPP base-builder StarRupture!

In the trailer, you’re gonna see an early glimpse of some of the combat and defense mechanics. You will also see the scale of some of the dangers you will encounter in StarRupture - such as the deadly waves of monster enemies, and most importantly - the Ruptura Star explosion, which scorches the planet’s land with a deadly wave of fire and a blast of (maybe quite important?) meteorites. 

[b]Jump into action in the teaser below: [/b]
[previewyoutube=cbe5Iu7DJVs;full][/previewyoutube][i]Everything you see in the video was live-captured from an early build on PC.[/i]

StarRupture has three main gameplay pillars—[b]base-building[/b], [b]exploration[/b], and [b]combat[/b]—and this action-packed trailer, taken from an early build, gives you a look at the pulse-pounding combat you’ll face in their bid for survival. 

Set in the far future, humanity has gone to the stars in search for precious resources. And the planet orbiting our namesake star, Ruptura, while being a resource-rich open world is also rife with dangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9b67fcd6c4f28204296ca6cad9841bfa8d4914a3.jpg[/img]
In the teaser clip, you see our lone explorer face off against hordes of enemies charging a custom-built base. If that isn’t enough, our exploding star is mere minutes from releasing an apocalyptic fire wave on the planet’s surface. 

All of our fighter’s vitals are looking good, but we're not forgetting our roots in survival and eagle-eyed viewers will notice not only the health and armour stats for our player/character, but also the thirst, toxicity, and hunger levels, as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04d0c536955ca35f04359de687a64813f552dda9.jpg[/img]
Utilizing collected resources to create ammunition to load turrets as one line of defense, the player is valiantly attempting to protect a base under a full-scale assault and there’s no time to waste.

As enemies make their way to destroy the base’s wind farm and storage buildings, a split-second decision is made to protect smelters and crafting pods from a terrifying new enemy assault on the other side of the base. 

While automated drones are busy zipping around their elevated tracks to deliver resources from location to location, the enemy assault becomes all but overwhelming. 
Making matters worse, our soldier looks up to see Ruptura ready to unleash its fiery blaze. With no time left to lose, the race is on to get to safety… but will he make it in time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/0d50a12105cd0afa3901c20cecc552657866f40d.jpg[/img]
StarRupture sets itself in the story of man versus nature taking place in an otherworldly and breathtaking sci-fi environment where elemental cataclysms of extreme temperatures loom as a constant danger. 

The player takes up the mantle of a convict exiled from the Earth to serve their sentence by mining and expanding industrial production alongside researching new technology on a seemingly hospitable new planet rife with mystery and danger. Tasked with surviving the deadly waves of elements—not to mention facing down against hostile enemy monsters in tense combat—each cycle spells destruction yet ushers in a new era of growth and rebuilding. 

Played from a first-person perspective—adventuring solo or as part of an up-to-4-player group in co-op mode—players will be able to explore, adapt, mine, gather resources, and build complex machinery to survive and prosper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/55d5dc477a493b2a35e28bac173a12b1c09d9c4e.jpg[/img]
Though by definition it is a base-building simulator, StarRupture is much more. The game will invite players to push beyond, to stay resilient and sharp against every assault, building and forming prior to the cycling eviscerating conditions on an otherwise beautiful planet. 

For fans of builders, management, sci-fi action, and combat StarRupture will challenge all comers to utilize the technology at their fingertips and weather both the extremities and fierce enemies in order to survive and create a prosperous industrial complex. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/517a9d4635d16ffc1e85e268cd5424f05c2f5d4a.jpg[/img]

How do you like our first capture of gameplay? We’d love to read your thoughts about it down in the comments section or on our [url=https://discord.gg/starrupture]official Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: Say “Hello” to StarRupture & watch our first devlog!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]We’re shedding the mythological shackles of the game’s previous title and proudly announcing a new name perfectly suited for our ambitious sci-fi setting![/b][/h3]

[h2]Hello Players![/h2]

Earlier this year, as part of the summer edition of the PC Gaming Show, we revealed our next game - a unique mix of base building, exploration, resource management, and combat on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction caused by its life-giving star. 

Now - we’re excited to reveal the game’s new title—one that we feel is much more representative of the unique world we’re creating—say hi to “[i]StarRupture[/i]”.

[previewyoutube=8AeQeigwU8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to this news, we’re launching our devlog series about the game. In the first part, we want to show you a deeper look into the name change and everything that the team’s been working on since the game’s reveal. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=RpzbZqdPth8;full][/previewyoutube]
As we work towards StarRupture’s Early Access PC launch, we will release further devlogs in the coming months for exclusive behind-the-scenes looks at the development process.

Everything from production milestones to sneak peeks at some of the game’s many mechanics, enemies, and mysteries are all on the table. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/9315edf005a0768aad17f6a0ce80a55d37e4c028.png[/img]
We’re excited to continue sharing with you more updates on StarRupture, as much as we were focused on doing so with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/815370/Green_Hell/]Green Hell[/url]. 

Wishlist and follow our game here on Steam, and our brand-new social media channels, to be the first to know about our future news for the game.
